description: This file defines a utility class Path within the namespace ScssPhp\ScssPhp\Util. The class provides static methods for handling filesystem paths, specifically for checking if a path is absolute and for joining path segments.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Utility class for handling filesystem paths, including checking for absolute paths and concatenating path segments.

methods.name: isAbsolute
methods.description: Determines whether a given filesystem path is absolute based on platform-specific rules.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Concatenates two path segments into one, inserting directory separators as needed.
